summary: Iteration 23 WEB + BACKEND regression on the new email-LINK password-reset flow. Backend: 14/14 pytest checks pass — /api/auth/forgot-password always returns 200 (no enumeration), surfaces dev_link in sandbox mode, invalidates the previous unused token on re-request; /api/auth/reset-password with a valid token updates the password and returns access_token+user (auto sign-in), token is single-use (reuse -> 400), invalid/garbage token -> 400, new_password < 6 -> 422; UserPublic no longer contains reset_pin_enabled; login + change-password + auth/me regress cleanly. Removed endpoints all return 404: /api/auth/verify-reset-code, /api/auth/forgot-password-pin, GET+POST /api/auth/reset-pin, /api/auth/has-pin. WEB UI: /login shows the Forgot? pill (points to /forgot-password); /forgot-password renders the form, submits, shows the 'Check your inbox' state with a dev-link button pointing at /reset-password?token=...; /reset-password without a token renders the invalid-link state (reset-no-token); mismatched passwords show an error and block submit; happy path resets the password, shows a 'Password updated' toast, auto-signs the user in, and redirects to / (home feed rendered). /settings no longer contains any Reset PIN card or 4-digit references; Change password card still present. Founder password was restored to Semi123! at the end so /app/memory/test_credentials.md stays valid.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:628 uses `rec['expires_at'].replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) < now()` to check expiry — this correctly handles Mongo's naive-UTC storage. Same fix pattern should be applied at routes/messages.py:219 for the still-open typing 500 bug.

ResetPassword.jsx redirects to `/` 900ms after success (setTimeout). That is fine, but on a slow browser the toast may still be visible when navigation fires — acceptable UX. Consider using navigate immediately and letting the toast persist.
ForgotPassword.jsx always shows 'Check your inbox' regardless of whether the email exists — correct behavior (no enumeration). dev_link button is only shown when sandbox surfaces one — correct.

APP_PUBLIC_URL is read once from env at process start (server.py). If APP_PUBLIC_URL is empty, dev_link becomes `/reset-password?token=...` (no host). Not a blocker in preview since APP_PUBLIC_URL is set, but consider raising at startup if unset in production.
